launch-film.name: Project teaser
launch-film.purpose: Follow one activity from capture to camera views and 3D motion.
lines: Project teaser
Follow one activity from capture to camera views and 3D motion.
launch-film.content: Suggested 30–60-second edit: establish the real action, then show camera observations and 3D output. Use one inspected episode, readable modality labels, captions, and a silent poster.
launch-film.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.

panels.name: Camera observations
panels.meaning: Show the same action from the cameras

capture-rig.name: Capture setup
capture-rig.purpose: Show the participant, wearable devices, motion-capture markers, and recording space.
lines: Participant + wearable devices + motion-capture space
Explain how the data is recorded
capture-rig.content: Use an actual collection photo with clear labels for the head and wrist devices and motion-capture markers. Device locations in an illustration must not be presented as verified calibration parameters.
capture-rig.source: New on-site photography; hardware labels reviewed with Aaron
capture-rig.format: Photo or annotated diagram · square / portrait

headset-detail.name: RoboCap close-up
headset-detail.purpose: Show the headset cameras and how the first-person observations are captured.
lines: Headset and camera placement
Explain the source of the egocentric views
headset-detail.content: Show the front and side of the device with simple camera-direction labels. Confirm camera count, resolution, and frame rate with the technical team before publication.
headset-detail.source: On-site device photos or approved hardware product images

wrist-detail.name: RoboWrist close-up
wrist-detail.purpose: Show the wrist-mounted view and sensor placement around hand interaction.
lines: Wrist-mounted device and close-range view
Explain how local interactions are observed
wrist-detail.content: Show how the device is worn and what its cameras see, using the hardware version used in the actual collection.
wrist-detail.source: Device photos; hardware version confirmed by the research team

ego-views.name: First-person camera views
ego-views.purpose: Show matched camera observations of the same hand–object interaction.
lines: Matched first-person camera views
Show hands, objects, and surrounding context
ego-views.content: Select a clear segment from an episode with complete reconstruction. Show camera views side by side and use the same segment in the body, hand, and scene tabs.
ego-views.source: A representative episode selected by the research team

body-motion.name: Whole-body reconstruction
body-motion.purpose: Connect the recorded action to a reconstructed body pose and trajectory.
lines: Recorded action alongside body reconstruction
Show whole-body posture and motion
body-motion.content: Use a quality-checked body mesh or skeleton render matching the first-person clip. The paper will define the final representation, such as SMPL-X or MHR.
body-motion.source: Body reconstruction approved by the research team
body-motion.format: Body mesh / skeleton render aligned with camera views

hand-tracking.name: EgoMotion hand annotations
hand-tracking.purpose: Pair hand tracks with the original camera observations from the same EgoMotion recording.
lines: Hand mesh and camera reprojection
Show fine interaction and tracking output
hand-tracking.content: Inspected hand tracks and camera reprojections from the same episode and time window as the body and object views.
hand-tracking.format: Hand close-up and reprojection comparison · final output pending

scene-reconstruction.name: Objects & scene geometry
scene-reconstruction.purpose: Show bodies, objects, and the scene together in a shared 3D space.
lines: Body, objects, and scene in the same space
Show the spatial context of the action
scene-reconstruction.content: Combine object meshes and trajectories, body motion, and scene reconstruction in one view. Use the same episode as the other modality tabs.

rerun-demo.name: Interactive Rerun viewer
rerun-demo.purpose: Let researchers inspect camera views, motion, and reconstruction on one timeline.
lines: Camera views, motion, and reconstruction
Inspect one real episode on a shared timeline
rerun-demo.content: The working five-second P03 / session 235 RRD contains two camera views, a BVH skeleton, and 53 TRC markers. Frame-rate alignment is provisional; fine synchronization is not yet reviewed.
rerun-demo.format: Same-origin Rerun 0.35.0 viewer and RRD file

activity-manipulation.name: Everyday manipulation
activity-manipulation.purpose: Show how hands, objects, and whole-body posture work together.
lines: A real tabletop manipulation example
Show coordinated hand, body, and object motion
activity-manipulation.content: Choose a representative tabletop activity with third-person footage and matching reconstruction. Use the task name from the final annotations.
activity-manipulation.source: Collection footage paired with a processed episode
activity-manipulation.format: Capture / reconstruction pair · short landscape video

activity-transport.name: Object transport
activity-transport.purpose: Show locomotion, body pose, and the movement of a carried object together.
lines: A real carrying or object-transport example
Show full-body motion and object interaction
activity-transport.content: Choose a carrying sequence with meaningful displacement, showing the whole body rather than only the hands. Confirm the required modalities are complete.
activity-transport.source: Collection footage paired with a processed episode
activity-transport.format: Third-person view + reconstruction · short landscape video

activity-interaction.name: Human interaction
activity-interaction.purpose: Show the spatial relationships between multiple people and shared objects.
lines: A real two-person interaction example
Show coordinated actions in a shared scene
activity-interaction.content: Select a clear segment from the shared two-person reconstruction samples and confirm it is approved for the release.
activity-interaction.format: Two-person scene / reconstruction · short landscape video

pipeline-figure.name: From capture to a data sample
pipeline-figure.purpose: Explain how raw streams become an aligned, processed, and inspected sample.
lines: From capture to a data sample
Explain how raw streams become an aligned, processed, and inspected sample.
pipeline-figure.content: Final processing description or scripts; stream clocks, temporal/spatial calibration, output representations, and quality filters. Distinguish measured signals from inferred outputs and name key file formats.
pipeline-figure.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.
pipeline-figure.format: Editable vector or high-resolution figure with matching panel labels and caption.

dataset-statistics.name: Released dataset statistics
dataset-statistics.purpose: Describe coverage, duration, and splits from the actual release manifest.
lines: Released dataset statistics
Describe coverage, duration, and splits from the actual release manifest.
dataset-statistics.content: Deduplicated release manifest: episode IDs, valid start/end times, task labels, anonymous subject IDs, scene IDs, available modalities, and train/validation/test splits. Agree on counting rules before calculating coverage and distributions.
dataset-statistics.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.
dataset-statistics.format: Editable vector or high-resolution figure with matching panel labels and caption.

panels.name: Task coverage
panels.meaning: Needs valid takes and duration per category

panels.name: Subjects, scenes, and splits
panels.meaning: Needs anonymous IDs, scenes, and split definitions

contributors.name: Authors & affiliations
contributors.purpose: Present the approved author order, affiliations, and authorized institutional marks.
lines: Approved authors, affiliations, and logos
Accurately credit the people behind the project
contributors.content: Use the final author order and institutional names from the paper, together with approved SVG logos. Add the official project title and BibTeX when confirmed.
contributors.source: Paper author list and approved institution logos
contributors.format: Author text and institutional SVG marks

paper-overview.name: Research overview
paper-overview.purpose: Connect the activity, camera observations, and measured body motion in one example.
lines: Research overview
Connect the activity, camera observations, and measured body motion in one example.
paper-overview.content: One representative episode: a scene photograph, head-camera view, measured motion, episode ID, and time window. Include only modalities confirmed for the release.
paper-overview.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.
paper-overview.format: Editable vector or high-resolution figure with matching panel labels and caption.

capture-system.name: Annotated capture system
capture-system.purpose: Explain what is worn, what surrounds the participant, and what each sensor records.
lines: Annotated capture system
Explain what is worn, what surrounds the participant, and what each sensor records.
capture-system.content: Front/side wearable photographs, device close-ups, a room overview, and verified sensor placement. Label RoboCap, RoboWrist, body markers, and capture volume; do not estimate specifications or accuracy.
capture-system.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.
capture-system.format: Editable vector or high-resolution figure with matching panel labels and caption.

panels.name: Participant and wearables
panels.meaning: Label RoboCap, RoboWrist, and body markers

panels.name: Capture volume and motion capture
panels.meaning: Label camera placement and capture volume

matched-modalities.name: One episode, multiple representations
matched-modalities.purpose: Inspect camera, body, hand, and object correspondence in one time window.
lines: One episode, multiple representations
Inspect camera, body, hand, and object correspondence in one time window.
matched-modalities.content: One inspected episode with head/wrist video, body motion, hand tracks, and object/scene representation. Include a common time window and coordinate documentation; do not combine different recordings as synchronized evidence.
matched-modalities.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.
matched-modalities.format: Editable vector or high-resolution figure with matching panel labels and caption.

benchmark-protocol.name: Evaluation protocol and results
benchmark-protocol.purpose: Define inputs, targets, splits, and metrics before comparing results.
lines: Evaluation protocol and results
Define inputs, targets, splits, and metrics before comparing results.
benchmark-protocol.content: Paper-approved tasks, inputs, reference targets, evaluation units, splits, baselines, metrics, and reproducible result files. State metric direction and protocol version; leave unmeasured results empty.
benchmark-protocol.source: Paper draft, inspected outputs, and release manifest; current capture material is reference only.
benchmark-protocol.format: Editable vector or high-resolution figure with matching panel labels and caption.

capture-replay.name: Development capture replay
capture-replay.purpose: Show camera, skeleton, and marker views in the capture tools. This is not the final teaser.
lines: Camera, skeleton, and marker views
Development capture recording
capture-replay.content: A 12-second development replay. It is not evidence of final reconstruction accuracy and is a separate recording from P03.

hand-method-reference.name: Hand-tracking method preview
hand-method-reference.purpose: Relate hand keypoints to the corresponding real camera observations.
lines: Hand mesh and camera reprojection
Show fine interaction and tracking output
hand-method-reference.content: This four-view hand-keypoint preview was shared by GSI on Slack. It uses an in-the-wild recording outside the EgoMotion motion-capture set. The final dataset hand-reconstruction clip is still pending.
hand-method-reference.source: GSI method demonstration shared from Google Drive on Slack; the later mocap preview thread is linked separately.
hand-method-reference.format: Hand close-up and reprojection comparison · final output pending
